The implementation is complete. Here's a summary of what was built:

**`output/CMakeLists.txt`** - CMake build configuration for C++20

**`output/main.cpp`** - Complete BibTeX 0.99c-compatible tool (~1670 lines) implementing:

- **BIB parser**: Handles all entry types, `@string` macros, `@preamble`, `@comment`, crossref inheritance, field value concatenation with `#`, quoted/braced/numeric/macro field values
- **BST stack machine**: All 37 built-in functions, 10 top-level commands (ENTRY, STRINGS, INTEGERS, FUNCTION, MACRO, READ, EXECUTE, ITERATE, REVERSE, SORT)
- **Name parsing**: Full 4-part decomposition (First/von/Last/Jr), all three comma forms, case-based von detection, brace-group handling
- **`format.name$`**: Faithful to bibtex.web - brace-level-1 literal output, abbreviated/full token output, default and custom inter-token separators, discretionary tie handling (§10351)
- **`change.case$`**: Title/lower/upper modes, brace protection, colon-space sentinel for title mode
- **`purify$`**: Special character restoration (13 recognized control sequences), whitespace/hyphen/tie-to-space conversion
- **`width$`**: Exact cmr10 character width table from bibtex.web §13, special character width handling (ss/ae/oe/AE/OE widths)
- **`substring$`**: Correct 1-based indexing with both positive and negative start positions per bibtex.web
- **Output buffer**: 79-column line wrapping with backward scan to column 3, forward-scan fallback, 2-space continuation indent, LF line endings, end-of-run flushing
- **Pre-defined**: `entry.max$` (250), `global.max$` (20000), `crossref` field, `sort.key$`, 12 month macros
- **JSON output**: Structured error/log output per the specification
- **CLI**: `--bib`, `--style`, `--cites`, `--aux`, `--output`, `--log` flags with proper validation
